adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `bookingCalendarReference` was changed from `find` to `filter` and is now looped (`for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`). Inside that loop, the recurring-series deletion path still builds `promises = bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...).map(...)` and sweeps `updatedBookings`, but for each `updBooking` it still uses `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`, i.e. only the first calendar reference per booking is deleted. Because this whole recurring sweep now runs once per `reference` (calendar ref) on the cancelled booking, it can execute the same sweep multiple times (duplicate deletes) and still only targets the first calendar ref on each updated booking, potentially leaving other calendar refs/events undeleted (orphaned) for collective/multi-calendar cases.
